devotionals.topic: Your Future Is in God's Word
devotionals.message: God's Word gives you a foundation for your future. As you grow, learn, and make decisions, allow His Word to guide your thinking and actions.
devotionals.application: Before making any big decision today, ask: does this align with God's Word?
devotionals.reflection: What is one area of your life where you need to apply God's Word more consistently?
devotionals.prayer: Father, help me to trust Your Word and walk in the purpose You have for my life. Amen.

devotionals.message: You carry the greatest message in the world. Never shrink back from your faith in Jesus—your boldness can inspire someone else to believe.
devotionals.application: Share one encouraging scripture or invite a friend to Teens Church today.
devotionals.reflection: Where can you show more boldness for Christ this week?
devotionals.prayer: Lord, give me boldness to represent You wherever I go. Amen.

devotionals.message: Everything you watch, listen to, and meditate on shapes your mindset. Guard your heart with truth, worship, and healthy habits.
devotionals.application: Replace 15 minutes of mindless scrolling with worship music or Scripture today.
devotionals.reflection: What inputs are feeding your mind the most right now?
devotionals.prayer: Father, help me guard my heart and fill my mind with what honours You. Amen.

devotionals.message: You don't have to figure everything out on your own. Christ's strength is available for your studies, your friendships, and your calling.
devotionals.application: Speak Philippians 4:13 aloud before your toughest task today.
devotionals.reflection: What challenge feels bigger than you right now?
devotionals.prayer: Lord, I lean on Your strength today. Thank You for empowering me. Amen.

devotionals.message: Age is not a barrier to spiritual maturity. Your speech, conduct, love, faith, and purity can lead others closer to God.
devotionals.application: Be the first to show kindness and integrity in your class or group today.
devotionals.reflection: Which of the five areas in 1 Timothy 4:12 do you want to grow in most?
devotionals.prayer: Father, make me an example of Your love and truth in my generation. Amen.
